Because transit trips are a leading indicator of non-essential out-of-home activity, continued transit erosion mechanically drags RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its t-0w value within 14 days of the WORKPLACES break below -15, or WORKPLACES recovers above -15 without any RETAIL_REC response.
